fields.name: Hdr_Parts
fields.fieldText:
Parts Used

Add one row per part — tap + Add Row for more. Each row becomes a child CustomFormPart__c record when you submit.

fields.name: Section_PartsAvailability
fields.fieldText: Parts Availability · 2-Column Section with Conditional Visibility

value.stringValue: Estimated Hours to Complete (enter 0 if done)

fields.name: Input_PartsStatus
fields.fieldText: Parts Status (visible when hours > 0)

fields.name: Hdr_LayoutRepeater
fields.fieldText:
Step 5b of 6 – 🔁 Parts via Repeater

Components: Repeater with nested Text + Counter. Each row becomes a CustomFormPart__c child record via an outer Loop + recordCreate at end-of-flow.

ℹ️ Tip: Use the + Add Row button below to add as many parts as you need — each row will save as its own child record.

fields.name: Hdr_Review
fields.fieldText:
Step 6 of 6 – ✅ Review & Submit

Double-check everything below before tapping Submit Report.
